note: Kokoro (via `hyperframes tts`). `at` is film time: a number, or a cue-sheet path plus an offset (seconds), e.g. `twin.clicks.1+0.9` = 0.9 s after the second click in the twin segment. Lines complement the picture rather than read the captions.

lines.text: Every chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear reading, in one live view.
In this synthetic run, a gamma monitor trends up.
AI fusion confirms it across three sources and opens an incident.
The 3D twin flies straight to it.
Every sensor reports live, and the wind layer shows where a release would drift.
Meanwhile, the ground robot reaches the equipment. In thermal, the hotspot stands out.
Insights show every source, and how much each counts.
But a person always makes the call.
The operator acknowledges, works the checklist, and adds a note.
Every step lands in the audit trail.
And the whole incident can be replayed, right in the twin.
